out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. Observed automatic paper towel dispenser not working.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CFM placed paper towels near hank sink for use.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: hotdog pretzel, pepperoni pretzel in hot holding cabinet.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. EHS discussed with CFM that 30 minute (time parameter being followed) end point be written down OR use a timer in 30 minute increments. End point time must be documented for hotdog pretzels and pepperoni pretzels.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: CREAM CHEESE AT 53F IN 1 DR UC.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM WILL NO LONGER USE 1 DR UC TO STORE TCS FOODS. CFM WILL ONLY STORE BOTTLED WATER IN UNIT.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2 DR UR OBSERVED WITH DIGITAL THERMOSTAT READING AT 35F. CFM OBSERVED AMBIENT TEMPERATURE OF UNIT USING CALIBRATED THERMOMETER AT 44F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. CFM PLACED THERMOMETER IN UNIT. CFM TURNED DOWN THERMOSTAT ON UNIT. CFM WILL CALL FOR REPAIR/SERVICE TO CHECK FUNCTIONALITY OF DIGITAL THERMOSTAT READING. CFM WILL VERIFY FOODS IN UNIT ARE 41F OR BELOW.
